svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
When it is seen: Bode plot measurement (gain and phase of a circuit) with a function generator
What to draw: from left to right: the function generator (with a sine wave on its display), the
circuit under test (a box with the input on the left and the output on the right) and the
oscilloscope. The generator output goes to the circuit input and, with a separate wire, to the
reference channel of the oscilloscope (CH1); the circuit output goes to the second channel
Details: the two probes identical, with a short ground spring; the input pick-up point close to
the circuit (not at the generator output). If you wish, a smaller box showing the loop gain
case (generator in series with the loop through a resistor or an injection transformer, dashed
because it is not always there).
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
